title: Garmin Metric0 Rolling 7-Day Value Average
dataSources: Garmin Zumo ride data (`garmin:zumo`), motorcycle OBD-II telemetry (`obd:bike`), RaceChrono laps (`racechrono:lap`), REVER rides (`rever:ride`), and RevZilla orders (`revzilla:order`).
app: Garmin Zumo ride exports, motorcycle OBD-II telemetry, RaceChrono track sessions, REVER ride logs, and RevZilla order history forwarded into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=garmin:metric0 value=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(value) as daily_avg by _time
| streamstats window=7 avg(daily_avg) as rolling_7d
| sort _time
description: Tracks a seven-day rolling average of daily value for garmin metric0 data.
value: Rolling averages highlight gradual drift without overreacting to one-off days.
implementation: Compute daily average `value` then a seven-day rolling mean for garmin metric0 events.
visualization: Line chart of daily and rolling average value.
grandmaExplanation: It treats the smoothed week-long trend in your value from garmin metric0.
